profile.name: Rafael P. Ramos
profile.title: Senior Android - Principal Mobile Engineer/Architect
profile.bio: Software Engineer with 10+ years of specialized experience in the mobile ecosystem, leading scalable architectures and delivering high-impact products across e-commerce, banking, and embedded automotive systems (AAOS). Focused on balancing technical trade-offs—such as performance, latency, and maintainability—while aligning engineering decisions with strategic business goals and operational efficiency.
profile.interests: Trade-off-oriented architecture, advanced concurrency, code maintainability, and design patterns. I work strongly across technical and people leadership, shaping cross-functional solutions between engineering (Mobile/Backend) and product stakeholders to ensure resilient, high-quality deliveries.
strengths: Design of complex and scalable architectures (Clean, MVVM, MVI)
Robust caching systems and offline resilience
Technical leadership, mentoring, and cross-team facilitation
UI/UX optimization and customization in high-concurrency scenarios

experience.companyDescription: ASA Investments — Multi-family office and asset manager focused on high-net-worth clients
highlights: Responsible for the architecture, prototyping, and development of the core Brokerage/Home Broker module, leading a complex WebView/API integration with Nelogica infrastructure for real-time trading on B3.

Implemented and managed the state of one of the ecosystem’s most complex interfaces: a high-density financial dashboard composed of multiple simultaneous charts, dynamic lists, on-demand pagination, and optimized local search.
Introduced rigorous predictable state-management patterns using Cubits, establishing architectures focused on performance and eliminating re-rendering bottlenecks.
Acted as a code-quality gatekeeper through code reviews focused on memory management (memory leaks), strict lifecycle control for declarative views, and reduced state-mutation overhead.
Engineer allocated to Volvo Cars’ in-house platform based on Android Automotive OS (AAOS).
Worked across ICUP, SPA1, SPA2, and SPA3 platforms (DHU 1.1, IHU 4.0, and memory-enhanced DHU 2.0 architectures).
Implemented features following AAOS UI patterns, including Panels and Scalable UI.
Main integration layer in Java; SystemUI components in Kotlin.
Every code change was covered by unit tests to ensure stability.
Managed workflow in Jira, documenting fixes, bugs, and incident records.
Analyzed Android bugreports with thousands of log lines across hardware and system layers.
Led both technical direction and people management for a multidisciplinary team of 9 engineers, managing the full product delivery lifecycle.
Served as a strategic focal point close to Business and Operations stakeholders, translating market requirements into scalable, highly resilient technical solutions.
Responsible for engineering trade-off management across the mobile ecosystem, ensuring high performance under aggressive concurrency scenarios while mitigating technical debt.
Promoted engineering culture and intrapreneurship through career development, advanced technical mentoring, and cross-functional facilitation.
Architected the BTG Investimentos app following Google-recommended guidelines.
Implemented features such as notifications, deep links, and analytics.
Improved build time by tuning Gradle scripts.
Integrated a facial-recognition SDK.
Lead developer for the core Trade Marketing module, responsible for integrating and extending it within the company’s proprietary Server-Driven UI engine.
Worked directly on the conception, design, and development of the company’s Server-Driven UI SDK, creating highly customizable and performant UI components (Custom Views) from scratch.
Provided technical leadership during the successful certification and rollout of the new architectural ecosystem for the company’s first enterprise client, ensuring stability and technical adherence.
Maintained a strong focus on SOLID principles, Clean Architecture, and componentization to reduce coupling and maximize code reuse across different tenants.
Supported the correct adoption of MVVM.
Executed heavy tasks using Executor from the Java API.
Implemented facial-recognition and document-OCR SDKs.
Contributed to the development of a proprietary Server-Driven UI SDK.
Built UI components from scratch.
Supported an international implementation for the first client in Mexico.
Built core engineering foundations and delivered features for mobile solutions.
